item.description:
## Sign up, roll in, and sit down to write postcards with old and new friends! Source: Indivisible Yolo (Mobilize)

item.title: Align & Flow Yoga — Thu Sep 3, 5:30 PM — Davis Shambhala Meditation Center
item.description:
All classes begin with a meditation and invite mindful movement through attention to breath and physical alignment. In a vinyasa class, we link postures together and move with the breath on the inhale, or the exhale. A typical class involves strength and stability work balanced by flexibility and relaxation. Each class finishes with a reclining rest.
davisyogacollective.com
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Karaoke Hero (Live Band Karaoke) — Thu Sep 3, 6:00 PM — Armadillo Music
item.description:
Ever wanted to perform your favorite song with a real live band? Karaoke Hero lets you take the stage as the singer while our band backs you up with professionally prepared tracks. Not much of a singer? Don’t worry! Jump on stage and rock out with the band with a guitar controller! No experience required to participate. 🎵 700+ songs spanning classic rock, pop, alternative, metal, and more. No experience? No problem! Everyone is welcome. When: Thursday September 3rd Doors @ 6:00 PM Show @ 6:30 PM Where: Armadillo Music, Davis, CA Bring your friends, cheer on other performers, or jump on stage and become the star of the show. We’d love to see you there! Song list: https://www.karaokeheroband.com/songs Join the queue: https://www.karaokeheroband.com/queue/armadillo-show-3
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Self Defense Class — Thu Sep 3, 6:00 PM — Davis Arts Center
item.description:
This is a safe, inclusive opportunity to learn self defense from a dedicated group of martial arts practitioners at the Davis Arts Center. If you have ever felt like you would like to learn a little more about how to defend yourself and your loved ones, and would like to get a little fitness training too, please join us! No experience necessary, start any time. We ask for a $10 donation per class, but you can pay whatever you can.
Source: The Dirt

item.description:
Join us for a lap-sit program for babies ages 0 to 18 months and their caregivers followed by a Stay-and-Play. We will share songs, lullabies, fingerplays, and board books!
The program is held indoors, in the Blanchard Room and is offered in two-month sessions. Each session is limited to 30 families.
This program is offered by registration only. In addition, all babies must have a Yolo County library account.
Source: Yolo Library

item.description:

Come participate in activities and learn to play the trading card game, and even take down powerful Pokémon in Raids! Materials are provided. Participants may bring their own deck, but we recommend you leave your most precious cards at home.
Source: Yolo Library

item.title: UpENDing Parkinson's at Rocknasium — Wed Sep 2, 10:00 AM — Rocknasium the Climbing Gym
item.description:
UpENDing Parkinson’s at Rocknasium Wednesdays, 10-11:30 AM Rocknasium is hosting UpENDing Parkinson’s, a non-profit that provides guided rock climbing to those living with Parkinson’s. Entrance is free, and rental gear is $10. Those interested may register as a climber here.

item.title: Davis Genealogy Club Library Hours — Wed Sep 2, 1:00 PM — Davis Senior Center
item.description:
Library Hours: Wednesdays, 1 – 3:30 p.m. (excluding holidays) This group assists and maintains the Senior Center’s extensive Genealogy Library, and in addition, hosts monthly lectures and meetings. During library hours, members are available to assist you with accessing research materials. Computer access is also available in the library for research purposes.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: The Bike Garage Open Hours: Davis Location — Wed Sep 2, 1:00 PM — Bike Garage Davis
item.description:
Davis location: 606 Peña Drive #300
FREE Bike Repair
Come to the Bike Garage, where our volunteer mechanics will repair your bike. We accept cash, Venmo, and Paypal donations. Interested in becoming a volunteer bike mechanic? No experience is necessary.

Hybrid bikes, town bikes, vintage bikes, road bikes, mountain bikes, kids’ bikes, and more. Visit the Bike Garage in Davis or Woodland to check out our inventory.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Bird Photography by Maya Mehta — Wed Sep 2, 3:00 PM — Super Owl Brewing
item.description:
Maya Mehta, an 8th grader in Davis, will be showing her bird photography at Super Owl Brewing in September. Maya started her birding and photography journey during the pandemic, when she was 7. Encouraged by her parents with an old camera, she has been sharing her pictures from India and the US regularly at local venues. This will be her 4th year sharing her pictures at Super Owl.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Davis Farmers Market — Wed Sep 2, 3:00 PM — Central Park
item.description:
Year-round at Central Park in downtown Davis, thousands gather each week to shop for what is grown, raised, and made locally at our markets. We are dedicated to bringing farmers right to your table, so we stay open rain or shine. Walk rows of stalls lined with an array of fruits and vegetables, including certified organic produce, choice meats, chicken, seafood, wine, local eggs and honey. Choose from a variety of fresh-baked goods, plants, flowers and gifts. Enjoy a picnic from one of our many food stands, made from market ingredients. See the vendor list here: https://www.davisfarmersmarket.org/our-sellers/ Farmers Market Hours Central Park: Saturdays 8a–1p (year-round), and Wednesdays 3p–6p (September through March); 4p–8p (April through August) UC Davis – North Quad: Wednesdays 10a–1:30p (fall and spring quarters) Sutter Davis Hospital: Thursdays 10a–1p (May through September) Sutter Medical Center, Sacramento: Thursdays 2:30p–5:30p
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Pub Quiz (Trivia) hosted by Dr. Andy — Wed Sep 2, 7:00 PM — Sudwerk Brewing Co.
item.description:
Sudwerk Trivia is a free, first come-first serve, all-ages event. Join us for a fun-filled evening of brain-teasing questions and friendly competition at Sudwerk’s Pub Quiz every Wednesday from 7-9pm! Put your knowledge to the test and gather your friends for a night of laughter and excitement. Location: 2001 2nd Street, Davis, CA 95618 You do not have to be 21+ to participate in trivia. There is no drink minimum.
Source: The Dirt

item.description:

Students will learn how to distribute different values to create balanced and sophisticated artwork while painting various subjects. Please note that this class is intended for participants who have previous experience with watercolor techniques and color blending. item.title: Human Relations Commission Meetings — Thu Nov 26, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
The Davis Human Relations Commission (HRC) meetings aim to promote mutual respect, understanding, justice, and advancing the human rights of all people. The Human Relations Commission meets on the fourth Thursday of each month at 6:30 p.m. The Commission takes a recess in July (no meeting in July).
Meetings take place in the Community Chambers at City Hall, 23 Russell Boulevard. For more information on meetings, membership, resolutions, and more, visit the Human Relations Commission site.
The HRC makes recommendations around equity and discrimination in the City, and supports the City in preventing and addressing discrimination while promoting diversity, equality, and justice relevant to the goals and policies of the City Council.
To contact or send emails to the commission, email: HRC@cityofdavis.org
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.title: Weekly Game Night at Blue Note — Wed Sep 16, 5:00 PM
item.description:
Yolo County Board Game Gathering Update 8/14/25: **We're still active**, but we primarily use Discord to chat and plan events. (See group description for invite link.)
We still meet every Wednesday for board games at Blue Note Brewing Company. We'll have a handful of tables reserved near the back; just look for the pile of board games.
People usually start arriving around 5pm, and games start whenever people are ready. Blue Note closes at 9pm, and although we have a 5-10 minute grace period there, you should be in the process of final scoring by 9, or else pack it up and play again another day.
Game night is open to all ages! Blue Note is a brewery, not a bar, so there's no restriction against minors. In addition to their crafted-in-house beer selection, water and sodas are available.
You're not required to buy anything in order to join us, but we do encourage you to support local businesses. Blue Note's chef team makes a mean pizza, and there are other nearby downtown restaurants
